# Testing syntax highlighting

## JavaScript example

```js
function greet(name) {
    return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}
console.log(greet('World'));
```

## Python example

```python
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

print(greet("World"))
```

## Plain (no language tag)

```
just plain text
no highlighting
```
